sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Missing Informant is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "The informant set up a meeting near the car dealership, at a hidden spot? So why the hell are you still here? If he gets busted while you're still here, look for a hidden hideout, a spare key for it must be somewhere in there too. Find everything he's dug up. Don't let me down."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Unlocks 10 hours after completion of Information Source

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the informant's hideout on Streets of Tarkov
  - (Optional) Obtain the key to the second hideout
- Locate the informant's backup hideout
- Obtain the informant's journal
- Bring the information to Lightkeeper

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
- 1× Microcontroller board
- Unlocks barter for Microcontroller board at Mechanic LL4
"It looks like the rumors have been confirmed after all. Someone really dared to start undermining me. These snakes are going to meet at the old federal reserve base, to transfer information. Come back later, while I figure out what to do about it."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Backup hideout key | 1 | Required | N/A | Used to open the second hideout |
| Informant's journal | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
In this quest you have to locate both of the informant's hideouts, and find his journal on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: First hideout
sections.text: The first hideout is an electrical operation room behind the small cinema. Inside the room is a sports bag which has a guaranteed Backup hideout key spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Second hideout and journal
sections.text: The second hideout is located inside the stairs to the cinema. A Backup hideout key is required to enter it. The journal has multiple spawns throughout the hideout.
